utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks the plan’s still being finalized and that you’ll send the details soon. Happy to help keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Jules — I’ll send the details as soon as I have them, and I’ll bring whatever spare tools and screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Noah — I’ll keep folks posted and pass along that you’re bringing spare tools and screws. Just let me know when the details are ready, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Of course—I’ll keep an eye out for the timing and let you know as soon as I hear back. And I’ll make sure we can fit the front gate repair around school pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye—that works. Just keep me posted, and I can help with supplies or anything else once the date’s set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll keep everyone posted as soon as the date’s set, and I’ll make sure the front gate repair fits around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the repair drive details yet—send me the date, time, and location, and I’ll keep it straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed on Maple Street. I’ll send the full details too, and we can use any extra tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Gus — I’ve got it: this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed on Maple Street. Send the full details when you can, and I’ll keep everything straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the exact day and time so I can make sure the pickup plan works with school. If you hear back first, could you let me know?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’m still pinning down the date and time, and I’ll let you know as soon as it’s set so you can line up the pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — I appreciate it. Once you have the time, I’ll adjust the school pickup plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and time right over. Hope you can make it to the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan and pass along any updates so everyone stays in the loop. If we need an extra hand, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you helping keep everyone updated. Send any changes my way, and I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’ll bring that squeaky chair by and ask around for a wrench, too. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I bet someone over there can help with both. Swing by and I’ll keep an ear out for anyone who’s got the right wrench.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You bet, Tess — I’ll swing by with the chair and see if I can spot that wrench. Thanks for keeping an ear out!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—it sounds like things are moving along. Let me know if you need a hand while you’re checking the rest.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know if anything comes up, and I’ll share the repair drive details as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Sam—thanks for keeping me posted. I’ll be around if you need anything while it all gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Mara. Send me the date, time, and location, and I’ll see if I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — it’s still on for today, and I’m heading over soon. I’ll send you the date, time, and location now, and text if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Mara. I’ll look for your text and plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — if you send me the date, time, and location, I’ll keep it straight, and let me know if you’re bringing any tools or parts too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — I’ll send the date, time, and location, and I’m checking for any spare tools or screws I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — that helps a lot. Send the details when you have them, and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re still good for today, right? Just text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m still good for today — I’ll text you right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — text me right away if anything shifts, will you?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Dane. If you can help with the repair drive, I’d be grateful—starting with the front gate would help me most.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely—I'll join a bit late, but I can jump in on the front gate as soon as I get there. I’ll bring the tools and help pick up where you leave off.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Dane. That helps a lot—once you arrive, starting with the front gate would be a relief.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the Sunday community center update noted, and I’ll keep the tools and checklist lined up. Send me any final details, and we’ll be ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Rosa — I’m still waiting on the final time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear it. In the meantime, I can bring my wrench and an hour if that still helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That still helps a lot, Nell — thanks. I’ll note your wrench and the hour, and I’ll keep the checklist ready for when the final time comes in.
